message: I remember the last time we had a blackout, and instead of panicking, I decided to make it a cozy family night. I grabbed my trusty flashlight, a few power banks for our devices, and we transformed the living room into a little sanctuary with blankets and snacks. We even played board games by flashlight! It turned a potentially stressful situation into a fun memory. How do you make the best of a blackout? I'd love to hear your tips! 😊
